[[Peltsman Jiri]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Altrumm Ruins}}

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Blood Drinker (NPC)|Blood drinker]]s are foul, disgusting creatures, but their hides are extremely useful. We can craft lightweight armor, warm clothing, durable pouches, and virtually anything else out of them. I'd venture into the wilderness to skin their pelts myself, but I'm far too busy haggling with armor smiths and garment makers to get my hands dirty. Business is raging harder than a diseased pack of [[Charr]]! You understand, don't you? Bring me 5 [[Blood Drinker Pelt]]s in exchange for this:"''
